messages:
jess_sales: Hey team — need quick deal-desk input. Nimbus Health asking for a 20% pilot discount + $50k pilot credit for a 3mo Dedicated POC (HIPAA scope). They want to move fast, procurement deadline EOM. Can we approve?

mike_deals: What’s the ask in plain numbers? ARR/committed spend if they convert?

jess_sales: Short version: POC billing estimate ~ $288k over 3 months list. If they convert to a 12mo commit after POC we expect ~$1.1M ARR. They require an ISO/HIPAA data path and private VPC option.

carla_pricing: 20% off is material on that size. Needs deal desk approval. Tell me the expected margin impact and whether they’re signing a committed contract post-POC. 

amy_finance: +1 on margin calc. Also need to know if pilot credit reduces recognized revenue or is an up-front rebate.

jess_sales: They’re signaling likely convert to 12mo committed Dedicated at about 80% of POC consumption. Procurement wants the pilot discount as a prerequisite to running the POC.

ethan_se: Technical note — private deployment + HIPAA will add integration time. Estimate 2 full engineer-days and private infra config. Not a blocker for timeline but factor in delivery cost.

carla_pricing: If conversion probability is high, we can do a structured offer: reduce immediate % off, add a convertible pilot credit that amortizes into the first 3 invoices of a committed contract. Example: 12% off + $25k pilot credit that converts to prepayment on conversion. That protects margin.

jess_sales: Procurement is pushing for headline 20% discount. They said other vendors offered similar. Is there precedent?

mike_deals: We’ve made similar concessions for healthcare customers but usually tied to an explicit commit or accelerated payment. Need approval from finance + legal for exceptions.

amy_finance: Quick math (rough):
```
List price (est): $0.08/token (example blended)
Est monthly tokens: 1.2B
Gross rev/mo: ~$96,000
3mo list rev: ~$288,000
20% off => revenue drops to ~$230,400 (delta ~$57,600)
Pilot credit $50k => effective first-period net further lower
```
So combined hit is large unless we get conversion guardrails.

carla_pricing: Propose counter: 15% off + $25k convertible pilot credit + commit clause: if they convert to 12mo committed Dedicated within 45 days, pilot credit applied to first invoice and 5% additional rebate (or keep 15%). If no conversion, pilot credit is one-time and discount stands at 15%.

jess_sales: That could work — procurement will push back but we can present as win-win. Can legal and finance pre-approve the template?

legal_bot: FYI — any convertible pilot credit needs language around offset and invoicing. I can draft a short addendum. Will need final SOW + security appendix.

amy_finance: I can provisionally approve the 15% + $25k convertible credit structure pending final ARR verification and SOC/HIPAA cost estimate. Need margin model in Salesforce.

mike_deals: Sounds reasonable. @carla_pricing, please confirm you’re comfortable with 15% on list at this band. If yes, I’ll mark as Deal Desk approved provisional and loop legal for addendum.

carla_pricing: I’m comfortable with 15% cap + the convertible credit. Mark as APPROVE_PROVISIONAL. Add clause: discount not combinable with other promotional credits.

dealbot: Discount request created: ID DB-2026-3097 — status: PROVISIONAL_APPROVED by carla_pricing + amy_finance. Next: legal addendum draft.

jess_sales: Thanks all — I’ll prep the SOW + procurement note. Will ping when legal draft is ready. :thumbsup:

ethan_se: I’ll start prepping HIPAA checklist and private VPC runbook in parallel so we don’t block delivery.

legal_bot: Drafting addendum now. ETA EOD tomorrow.

jess_sales: Closing loop — thanks team. I’ll update the SFDC opp with the approved structure and attach the deal desk ID.
